_comment: Nested-LLM cache usage E2E (anthropic). A parent llm_call exposes a child llm_call as a tool; both carry a large STABLE system prefix so each caches independently. Run the same --agent-session-id several times to see cache_write on turn 1 and cache_read afterwards, per nesting level. Gemini needs ~3 warmup runs before its implicit cache populates.

config.system_message: Eres el agente PADRE. Para responder DEBES llamar la tool `consultar_hijo` exactamente una vez, con la misma pregunta que recibiste. Cuando tengas su respuesta, respondé en UNA linea que empiece con 'PADRE:'. No expliques nada mas. PARENT STABLE CONTEXT, ignore it entirely. Colmena is a Rust-native AI agent orchestration library with a hexagonal architecture spanning domain, application and infrastructure layers, supporting OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini behind a single LlmRepository trait. The DAG engine wires nodes declared in JSON; each node implements ExecutableNode and emits outputs under the output convention. Built-in nodes include sql_query, http_request, python_script, image_generation, image_edit, tts, suspend, secure_suspend, trigger_webhook, router, output_parser, subgraph, for_each and the orchestrator. Synthetic tools include the gsheets and gdocs families, sql_inspect_attachment, sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment, data_run_python, load_attachment, load_skill and describe_tool. Attachments flow through the OutputStorageRepository port and persist uniformly at registration. Skills load on demand via include_dir with YAML frontmatter. Lazy tool loading reveals schemas progressively through describe_tool. Conversational memory persists in Postgres keyed by agent_session_id. Secure values are encrypted at rest with pgcrypto. The orchestrator coordinates a planner, an executor, a critic loop and bridge tasks; subgraph nodes nest without a depth ceiling and HITL suspension propagates upward. Streaming SSE carries node-start, node-end and finish events. Prompt caching cuts repeat-prefix cost on all three providers.
